name: ESP32 Dev Board
fullName: ESP32 NodeMCU Wi-Fi & Dual-Mode Bluetooth 30-Pin / 38-Pin Development Board
tagline: Dual-Core 240MHz SoC with built-in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth BLE, and hardware crypto accelerators
description: The ESP32 is a powerful microcontroller board based on the Espressif ESP-WROOM-32 module. With dual Xtensa 32-bit LX6 CPU cores operating up to 240 MHz, integrated 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth 4.2 / BLE, it is ideal for advanced IoT, machine learning edge computing, and robotics.

specs.wireless: Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n (up to 150 Mbps) + Bluetooth v4.2 BR/EDR and BLE
specs.gpio: 36 GPIO pins with capacitive touch, 12-bit ADC, 8-bit DAC, I2C, SPI, UART, PWM

pinout.name: Power In
pinout.desc: 5V power input from external supply or USB

wiringNote: All GPIO pins operate at 3.3V logic levels. Do NOT connect 5V signals directly to ESP32 pins without logic level converters.
commonMistakes: Applying 5V directly to GPIO pins (ESP32 is NOT 5V tolerant)
Using strapping pins (GPIO 0, 2, 12, 15) for normal peripherals causing boot failures
